request.prompt:
A full-body reference image of Bi11bot standing beside human-scale workshop equipment, showing his child-sized proportions and handmade construction. The image should make him read as a built machine and companion, not a seamless humanoid android.

Must be shown, exactly as written: If a witness or archive function is suggested visually, it must remain an offline physical record or machine-held record. Bi11bot authenticates events as the B11 witness; he does not visually read as a sovereign command device. `(characters.md; rules/decisions.md)`

Not established, so your choice: The casino chip, physical key socket, offline record carrier, or an analog/isolated communication component may appear as secondary objects, because each is established in the files.

Must not appear: Do not depict Bi11bot as independently deciding whether Adrian’s transfer is valid or as directly granting Alex power. `(characters.md; rules/decisions.md)`

No lettering of any kind: no captions, labels, signage, logos, numbers, speech balloons or on-screen text, unless the brief requires a specific one. Concept reference, not finished comic art; no panel borders.

Add nothing that tells a story of its own: no invented symbols, emblems, documents or events. Render the description, not an interpretation of it.
